justification: Inspected byte-buddy-agent/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/VirtualMachine.java (lines 2393-2465) and found UsingStat is a small nested helper with 3 fields, 1 constructor, and 1 public method. Its only responsibility is invoking the external `stat` command, waiting for completion, and parsing the returned owner id. It sits alongside a parallel PosixOwnerProvider implementation (UsingIStat), and there is no sign of many methods, broad responsibilities, or low cohesion that would indicate insufficient modularization.
